heading: Why I'm Running
text: I’m running because families in Miami can’t afford to live here anymore, because our democracy is under real stress, and because the politics of cruelty toward immigrants is not who we are. I’ve spent forty years telling South Florida’s story. Now I want to fight for it.

heading: Why I'm Running
text: Affordability is the defining economic issue for working families right now. Groceries cost more. Insurance costs more. Borrowing costs more. And for too many households, wages have not kept pace. People feel squeezed.

heading: Why I'm Running
text: And making South Florida affordable again

heading: Lowering the Cost of Living
text: South Florida has become too expensive for the vast majority of residents. Eliott will focus on the bills families actually pay—housing, insurance, healthcare, groceries, utilities, and transportation. He believes government should help create more competition, increase the supply of housing, and make it easier for working people to get ahead. Eliott’s most immediate priorities upon entering Congress are:

heading: Lowering the Cost of Living
text: Identifying underused federal land and converting it into affordable mixed-use housing.

heading: Lowering the Cost of Living
text: Expanding incentives for workforce housing, first-time homeownership, and construction near transit and employment centers.

heading: Lowering the Cost of Living
text: Creating a preferential interest rate program for public servants, such as teachers, police, firefighters, and sanitation workers.

heading: Lowering the Cost of Living
text: Pressure the Trump Administration to withdraw from Iran to lower gas prices and negotiate with experts on a nuclear deal.

heading: Lowering the Cost of Living
text: Enforcing antitrust laws designed to increase competition and drive down consumer costs, particularly in the grocery industry where middlemen are responsible for much of the cost increases.

heading: Lowering the Cost of Living
text: Pursuing a federal backstop to help stabilize Florida’s catastrophic homeowners-insurance market.

heading: Lowering the Cost of Living
text: Protecting consumers from price-fixing, hidden fees, and corporate practices that drive up essential costs.

heading: Protecting Medicare, Social Security, and Healthcare
text: Medicare and Social Security are promises Americans earned through a lifetime of work—not bargaining chips for politicians in Washington. Eliott will oppose efforts to privatize them, cut benefits, raise the retirement age, or shift more healthcare costs onto seniors and working families. Eliott will:

heading: Protecting Medicare, Social Security, and Healthcare
text: Protect Medicare, Social Security, Medicaid, and Affordable Care Act coverage.

heading: Protecting Medicare, Social Security, and Healthcare
text: Allow Americans between 55 and 64 to buy into Medicare voluntarily.

heading: Protecting Medicare, Social Security, and Healthcare
text: Lower prescription-drug costs and strengthen preventive and community-based care.

heading: Protecting Medicare, Social Security, and Healthcare
text: Ask the wealthiest Americans to contribute more of their income so Social Security remains strong for future generations.

heading: Secure Borders, an Orderly System, and Humane Treatment
text: America does not have to choose between enforcing its laws and treating people with dignity. Eliott supports a secure border, law and order, faster and more orderly immigration processing, the removal of people who pose genuine threats, and comprehensive reform for immigrants who work, obey the law, and contribute to their communities. Eliott will prioritize:

heading: Secure Borders, an Orderly System, and Humane Treatment
text: Increasing border, immigration-court, and asylum-processing capacity so cases are decided promptly.

heading: Secure Borders, an Orderly System, and Humane Treatment
text: Protecting Dreamers and providing fair treatment for families with deep roots in America.

heading: Secure Borders, an Orderly System, and Humane Treatment
text: Supporting appropriate protections for Venezuelans and Haitians and fair processing for eligible Cubans with unresolved I-220A cases.

heading: Independent Leadership and Real Accountability
text: Eliott spent nearly five decades asking tough questions and holding powerful people accountable. In Congress, he will answer to the people of South Florida—not party bosses, wealthy donors, corporate interests, or any president. Eliott will work tirelessly to:

heading: Independent Leadership and Real Accountability
text: Fight corruption, self-dealing, conflicts of interest, and the misuse of public office.

heading: Independent Leadership and Real Accountability
text: Institute a ban on members of Congress or the Executive Branch trading individual stocks.

heading: Independent Leadership and Real Accountability
text: Demand transparency in the Epstein investigation and the release of all records the Epstein Files Transparency Act mandated, while protecting victims’ identities.

heading: Independent Leadership and Real Accountability
text: Support strong ethics rules and meaningful disclosure requirements for members of Congress and senior government officials.

heading: Independent Leadership and Real Accountability
text: Judge legislation and investigations on the facts, regardless of which party is involved.

heading: Standing Up to Trump and Defending Democracy
text: No president is above the law. Eliott will stand up to Donald Trump whenever he abuses the power of the presidency, attacks constitutional rights, or puts personal loyalty ahead of the country. He will use Congress’s oversight authority seriously—not as political theater, but as a constitutional responsibility. Eliott will:

heading: Standing Up to Trump and Defending Democracy
text: Defend free and fair elections, voting rights, an independent judiciary, and the peaceful transfer of power.

heading: Standing Up to Trump and Defending Democracy
text: Investigate executive misconduct and follow the evidence wherever it leads.

heading: Standing Up to Trump and Defending Democracy
text: Protect the independence of law enforcement and reject political retaliation against critics.

heading: Standing Up to Trump and Defending Democracy
text: Reassert Congress’s constitutional authority over spending, war powers, and executive action.

heading: A Strong Economy Built on Fair Competition
text: Eliott believes in capitalism, entrepreneurship, and the ability of people to build something of their own. His parents were union workers who later became small-business owners, teaching him that workers and businesses succeed together. Government should establish fair rules and keep markets competitive—not attempt to control private companies or choose winners and losers. Eliott will work to:

heading: A Strong Economy Built on Fair Competition
text: Oppose the Trump administration’s government acquisition of ownership stakes in private businesses and introduce legislation requiring the government divest those interests in an orderly fashion.

heading: A Strong Economy Built on Fair Competition
text: Support small businesses, organized labor, and fair competition.

heading: A Strong Economy Built on Fair Competition
text: Create incentives for innovation while still regulating technological sectors that threaten the welfare and safety of everyday Americans.

heading: A Strong Economy Built on Fair Competition
text: Require wealthy individuals and large corporations to pay their fair share without punishing ordinary families or legitimate small businesses.

heading: Protecting South Florida’s Environment
text: For South Florida, protecting the environment is not an abstract ideological issue. It is about clean drinking water, stronger neighborhoods, affordable insurance, protecting the Everglades and Biscayne Bay, and ensuring that future generations can continue to live here. Eliott believes we need to:

heading: Protecting South Florida’s Environment
text: Invest in Everglades restoration, clean water, resilient infrastructure, and protection of Biscayne Bay.

heading: Protecting South Florida’s Environment
text: Help communities address flooding, extreme heat, stronger storms, and rising insurance costs.

heading: Protecting South Florida’s Environment
text: Hold polluters accountable rather than leaving taxpayers to pay for the damage.

heading: Protecting South Florida’s Environment
text: Expand cleaner energy while protecting affordability, reliability, and good-paying American jobs.

heading: Strength Abroad, Accountability at Home
text: America is strongest when it leads with confidence, works with trusted allies, and stands up to dictators. Eliott supports a foreign policy that protects Americans, strengthens democratic alliances, and avoids reckless, open-ended wars. Presidents of either party must come to Congress before committing the country to prolonged military conflict. Eliott will push for the Trump Administration and the next Congress to:

heading: Strength Abroad, Accountability at Home
text: Repair relationships with NATO and other democratic allies while requiring partners to share responsibility.

heading: Strength Abroad, Accountability at Home
text: Outright oppose authoritarian regimes and support democratic nations defending themselves.

heading: Strength Abroad, Accountability at Home
text: Require clear objectives, congressional authorization, appropriate oversight, and a realistic exit strategy before prolonged military action.

heading: Strengthening Labor While Fostering Economic Growth
text: Eliott is the son of two union workers who went on to own a small business. America needs a strong and economically stable workforce in order to be at its best. When businesses have too much power, income inequality rises and crises, like the economic one we face today, begin to mount. Eliott believes the current path where workers are increasingly powerless is unsustainable. However, Eliott also knows that businesses, especially small businesses, are the reason America thrives. Eliott will push to:

heading: Strengthening Labor While Fostering Economic Growth
text: Have a functioning and balanced National Labor Relations Board that enforces laws to protect workers.

heading: Strengthening Labor While Fostering Economic Growth
text: Enact laws that protect government workers, such as the Public Service Freedom to Negotiate Act.

heading: Strengthening Labor While Fostering Economic Growth
text: Incentivize businesses to create more high-paying American jobs by providing tax breaks to companies that meet certain wage standards and that do not outsource jobs to other countries.

heading: Common-Sense Gun Safety
text: Eliott supports common-sense gun safety measures that protect our children and communities while respecting the rights of responsible gun owners. He supports Ethan’s Law to require safe firearm storage and supports restoring a federal ban on assault weapons and high-capacity magazines. He also supports universal background checks to help keep guns out of the hands of people who should not have them.

heading: Common-Sense Gun Safety
text: Support passage of Ethan’s Law to require safe firearm storage and help prevent children from accessing unsecured firearms.

heading: Common-Sense Gun Safety
text: Restore the federal ban on assault weapons and high-capacity magazines.

heading: Common-Sense Gun Safety
text: Require universal background checks for all firearm sales to help keep guns out of the hands of people who are legally prohibited from possessing them.
